title: Cater Station
subtitle: SaaS Platform
cardDescription: A multi-role event and catering platform with booking workflows, payout handling, and dedicated dashboards for different user roles.
fullDescription: Cater Station is a SaaS-based event and catering management platform designed to support multiple user roles within one system. The application streamlines booking operations, payout management, and role-based dashboards to provide a smooth experience for administrators, vendors, and service providers. It was built to manage complex workflows in the catering and events domain while maintaining clear separation of responsibilities and scalable architecture.

title: Parking Management System
subtitle: Smart Parking Solution
cardDescription: A smart parking app with POS and Sunmi printer integration, invoice generation, and QR-based vehicle tracking.
fullDescription: Parking Management System is a smart parking solution built to simplify parking operations through digital tracking and automated invoicing. The application supports POS workflows and Sunmi printer integration for fast invoice generation, while QR-based vehicle tracking helps manage entries and exits more efficiently. It was designed to improve operational accuracy, reduce manual work, and provide a reliable workflow for parking businesses.

title: Wafy Restaurant POS
subtitle: Tablet-based POS
cardDescription: A restaurant POS application with offline-first menu caching, table management, and invoice handling for tablet devices.
fullDescription: Wafy Restaurant POS is a tablet-based restaurant management application designed to support day-to-day operations inside dining environments. The system includes offline-first menu caching, table state management, and invoice workflows to ensure stable performance even when connectivity is limited. It was built to help restaurants manage orders, tables, and billing more effectively while delivering a responsive and practical point-of-sale experience.

title: DrDrugJo
subtitle: Medical Reference Platform
cardDescription: A healthcare reference app that combines drug data, medical learning tools, quizzes, and career resources for doctors, pharmacists, and healthcare professionals.
fullDescription: DrDrugJo is a healthcare reference platform built for doctors, pharmacists, and healthcare professionals in Jordan and the Arab region. It combines a comprehensive medicine database with verified medical references, helping users access important pharmacological details such as dosages, interactions, and updated drug information. Beyond reference content, the app supports professional growth through interactive quizzes, tests, certificates, and learning progress tracking. It also includes a career and community section with medical job opportunities, healthcare updates, and notifications about new drugs and industry news. The platform is designed to serve as an educational and professional resource in one application, while remaining strictly informational rather than diagnostic or treatment-focused.

title: Invotek Company Management
subtitle: Enterprise Management
cardDescription: An enterprise management system for products, customers, expenses, and tax invoices with detailed permission control.
fullDescription: Invotek Company Management is an enterprise business solution built to manage core company operations in one place. The system covers products, customers, expenses, and tax invoices while supporting granular user permissions for different staff roles. It was designed to improve internal workflow organization, financial tracking, and operational control, making it suitable for businesses that need structured access management and reliable administrative tools.

title: Halla App
subtitle: Smart Networking
cardDescription: A smart networking app for digital contact sharing through QR, NFC, and AI-generated job tags with offline and cloud sync support.
fullDescription: Halla App is a smart networking platform built to modernize how users exchange and manage professional contacts. The application supports digital contact sharing through QR codes and NFC, while also using AI-generated job tags to enrich profile discovery and categorization. It includes offline syncing capabilities and supports both local and cloud storage, making it practical for real-world networking scenarios where internet availability may vary. The project was designed with a scalable architecture to support profile sharing, synchronization, and contact management in a modern mobile experience.

title: Wasla App
subtitle: Graduation Project
cardDescription: A smart delivery collaboration app connecting users with travelers to buy and ship products across cities with chat and payment integration.
fullDescription: Wasla App is a smart delivery collaboration platform that connects users who want to purchase products from other cities with travelers who can deliver them. The application includes secure in-app chat for communication, Paymob integration for digital payments, and NLP-based functionality to enhance parts of the user experience. Built as a graduation project, it focuses on solving practical delivery and marketplace coordination challenges through a mobile-first approach with real-time communication and secure workflows.

title: Taagira App
subtitle: Car Rental App
cardDescription: A car rental platform that allows users to rent or list vehicles with location-based search and secure authentication.
fullDescription: Taagira App is a mobile car rental platform built from scratch to allow users to browse, rent, or list vehicles through a simple and secure experience. The app includes location-based search to help users discover relevant cars nearby and uses secure authentication to support trusted access to the platform. It was designed to provide a clear rental flow for both customers and vehicle owners while keeping the experience intuitive and scalable.

title: V-School App
subtitle: Education Management
cardDescription: A school management platform that helps teachers manage lessons, attendance, assignments, and real-time educational workflows.
fullDescription: V-School App is an education management platform designed to support teachers and school workflows through a connected mobile experience. The app enables lesson management, attendance tracking, and assignment handling while using real-time synchronization to keep educational data updated. It was built to simplify day-to-day academic operations and provide a more organized digital environment for school management and teacher productivity.
